newsitem.title: GREECE: FORECAST -Greek April inflation seen at 5.7pct yy.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST -Greek April inflation seen at 5.7pct yy.

text.p: Greece's consumer price inflation will fall to 5.7 percent year-on-year in April from 6.0 percent in March according to an informal Reuters poll.
Fifteen bankers and other economists participated in the poll which produced a mean forecast of 5.7 percent. Forecasts ranged from 5.5 percent to 6.0 percent.

CPI-based inflation plunged to 6.0 percent year-on-year in March from 6.6 percent in February. But core inflation which does not include volatile food and energy prices crawled higher to 7.5 percent in March from 7.3 percent in February, a foreign bank said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
